title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Currently pursuing a degree in CS or related technical discipline; proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python.
description: Work on real-world software engineering projects, build scalable features, and receive mentorship from senior engineers across various Microsoft product divisions.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from participating foreign countries.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, airfare, health insurance)
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with a strong academic record; English proficiency.
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in universities across the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, and Git version control.
description: Build scalable web UI components for GitLab's DevOps platform, collaborate with cross-functional asynchronous teams, and maintain code quality.

title: Associate Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of relevant analytical experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, or related field; proficiency in SQL.
description: Transform complex data sets into actionable insights, create business intelligence dashboards, and support key decision-making across Google product teams.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education globally.
qualification: Teams of up to 4 students submitting an innovative technology project leveraging cloud computing.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to build creative tech solutions that address critical global and community challenges.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access; no prior coding required.
description: An entry-level course teaching students fundamental computer science concepts, algorithmic thinking, and programming languages including C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
